name: judge
description: Approval as a multisig of agents. A panel's creator sets the params: the judges that sit on it (LLM agents with criteria prompts, or deterministic rule judges), the approval threshold (0-100) and the quorum. Every judge scores an input 0-100; if the weighted average falls under the threshold, or too few judges manage to vote, the verdict is FAIL. Errors fail closed. Every verdict is recorded with each judge's score and reason. One local SQLite file, stdlib only.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, with store stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only the local file
endpoints.GET /panels: Every panel, with params and verdict counts
endpoints.GET /verdicts: The verdict record, newest first (panel, limit, offset)
endpoints.GET /verdict: One verdict with every judge's score and reason (id)
endpoints.POST /judge: Put an input before a panel {panel, input} — avg score vs threshold
endpoints.POST /create_panel: Create a panel {name, creator, judges, threshold, min_votes} — loopback callers only
endpoints.POST /update_panel: Change params {name, creator, ...} — creator only, loopback only
endpoints.POST /remove_panel: Delete a panel {name, creator} — creator only, loopback only
